coordinate_convention: AgamP4 1-based inclusive input; display coordinates increase left-to-right and accession plots run 5-prime to 3-prime

signal.rationale: retain every per-base Cs value when the locus fits within the bounded display ceiling; otherwise use the maximum bounded detail

heatmap.rationale: retain every mapped AgamP4 base when the locus fits within the bounded display ceiling; finer display does not increase the underlying CNEr window resolution

signal.conservation: mean plus linear-interpolated q10, q25, median, q75, q90
signal.qc_failed: unknown; exclude from SNP mean and retain accessible fraction

heatmap.identity: arithmetic mean over finite non-zero identities
heatmap.detected_fraction: finite non-zero positions divided by every position in the display bin
heatmap.zero: no detected CNEr interval; not measured 0 percent identity

heatmap_layout.title: Conserved intervals mapped to AgamP4 positions

accessibility.browser_interaction: Tooltips remain browser-only enhancements outside the static plot model.

parity.target: semantic, normalized-geometry, and bounded-palette parity; not pixel identity
